purpose: Model a declared, limited, explicitly consented, and reversible data transfer from a human to an AI service for analysis.
claim: A human shares a research artifact with an AI service under explicit consent, limited to analysis, and reversible via deletion.
invariants: Consent is required for the exchange
Use of the artifact is limited to analysis
The exchange is reversible through deletion of the artifact
consequences: Enables analysis of the artifact by the AI service
Potential misuse if consent boundaries are violated
Ability to restore prior state via deletion
recovery: Data deletion restores the pre-exchange state
notes: No unresolved unknowns were identified from the supplied material; invariants are derived from the guard operation and source statement.
